headline: Late Exchanges Center on Stonecradle, Linn Mercy
war_summary: Since the 03:15 edition Stonecradle has added four changes in two hours to 04:57, lifting the day's tally to twenty-one about Buckler Sound, The Reach and The Heir's Knife and standing now at three Warden to six Colonial with no unheld, with 10,453 Colonial and 15,669 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours, while Linn Mercy added three in two hours to the 06:15 cutoff about Lathair and Rotdust for twenty-two in the day and remains eleven Colonial to none with 4,113 and 6,794 losses. New matter comes from Stlican Shelf with two changes to 04:35 about Thornhold at six Warden to three Colonial, and Mooring County with two to 03:40 about The Wind Hills at eleven Warden to one Colonial amid sharply quickened casualty rates. Farranac Coast, Fisherman's Row, Gutter and the Weathered Expanse, busy about 01:15 to 01:57, record no changes in the last two hours, the latter still listing 11,193 and 12,037. Callahan's Passage, Marban Hollow and Nevish Line show heavy day lists with no fresh flips.
